12051-dick-sand-a-captain-at-fifteen.title: Dick Sand A Captain At Fifteen
12051-dick-sand-a-captain-at-fifteen.creator: Jules Verne,
12051-dick-sand-a-captain-at-fifteen.description: A book by Jules Verne,. This vessel, of four hundred tons, fitted out at San Francisco for whale-fishing in the southern seas, belonged to James W. Weldon, a rich Californian ship-owner, who had for several years intrusted the command of it to Captain Hull.

arxiv-2008-00182.title: Challenges in teaching Real Analysis classes at the University of PGRI, South Sumatra, Indonesia
arxiv-2008-00182.creator: E. Septiati, N. Karjanto
arxiv-2008-00182.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by E. Septiati, N. Karjanto. This paper discusses our experiences and challenges in teaching advanced undergraduate Real Analysis classes for Mathematics Education students at the University of PGRI ( Persatuan Guru Republik Indonesia , Indonesian Teachers Association) Palembang, South Sumatra, Indonesia. We observe that the syllabus contains topics with a high level of difficulty for the students who are specialized in education and intend to teach mathematics at the secondary level.

arxiv-2008-10244.title: A completely annotated whole slide image dataset of canine breast cancer to aid human breast cancer research
arxiv-2008-10244.creator: Marc Aubreville, Christof A. Bertram, Taryn A. Donovan, Christian Marzahl, Andreas Maier, Robert Klopfleisch
arxiv-2008-10244.description: Abstract Canine mammary carcinoma (CMC) has been used as a model to investigate the pathogenesis of human breast cancer and the same grading scheme is commonly used to assess tumor malignancy in both. One key component of this grading scheme is the density of mitotic figures (MF).

arxiv-2107-03242.title: Robustifying Multi-hop Question Answering through Pseudo-Evidentiality Training
arxiv-2107-03242.creator: Kyungjae Lee, Seung-won Hwang, Sang-eun Han, Dohyeon Lee
arxiv-2107-03242.description: Abstract This paper studies the bias problem of multi-hop question answering models, of answering correctly without correct reasoning. One way to robustify these models is by supervising to not only answer right, but also with right reasoning chains. An existing direction is to annotate reasoning chains to train models, requiring expensive additional annotations.

arxiv-2205-10456.title: PSO-Convolutional Neural Networks with Heterogeneous Learning Rate
arxiv-2205-10456.creator: NGUYEN HUU PHONG 1, AUGUSTO SANTOS 2 , AND BERNARDETE RIBEIRO 3
arxiv-2205-10456.description: Abstract Convolutional Neural Networks (ConvNets or CNNs) have been candidly deployed in the scope of computer vision and related fields. Nevertheless, the dynamics of training of these neural networks lie still elusive: it is hard and computationally expensive to train them.

arxiv-2206-08296.title: Finite temperature dielectric properties of KTaO 3 from first principles and machine learning: Phonon spectra, Barrett law, strain engineering and electrostriction
arxiv-2206-08296.creator: Quintin N. Meier, Natalio Mingo, Ambroise van Roekeghem
arxiv-2206-08296.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Quintin N. Meier, Natalio Mingo, Ambroise van Roekeghem. Despite important breakthroughs in the last decade, the calculation of temperature dependent properties of solids still remains a challenging task, especially in the vicinity of structural phase transitions. We show that the combination of machine-learning interatomic potentials with quantum self-consistent ab initio lattice dynamics allows to calculate efficiently the temperature dependence of dielectric properties of the quantum paraelectric perovskite KTaO 3 , with a precision beyond what could be reasonably achieved using plain density functional theory.

arxiv-2310-06089.title: Predictive auxiliary objectives in deep RL mimic learning in the brain
arxiv-2310-06089.creator: Ching Fang, Kimberly Stachenfeld
arxiv-2310-06089.description: Abstract The ability to predict upcoming events has been hypothesized to comprise a key aspect of natural and machine cognition. This is supported by trends in deep reinforcement learning (RL), where self-supervised auxiliary objectives such as prediction are widely used to support representation learning and improve task performance.

arxiv-2402-10707.title: Semi-algebraic Geometry and generic Hamiltonian stability
arxiv-2402-10707.creator: S. Barbieri, 585 - 08007 Barcelona, Spain
arxiv-2402-10707.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by S. Barbieri, 585 - 08007 Barcelona, Spain. Mathematics subject classification:
37CXX - Smooth dynamical systems: general theory, 14PXX - Real algebraic and real-analytic geometry. Keywords:
Hamiltonian dynamical systems, Nekhoroshev Theory, steepness, semi-algebraic geometry. Abstract

The steepness property is a local geometric transversality condition on the gradient of a
C^{2}
-function which proves fundamental in order to ensure the stability of sufficiently-regular nearly-integrable Hamiltonian systems over long timespans. Steep functions were originally introduced by Nekhoroshev, who also proved their genericity.

arxiv-2408-03095.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Siqi Gu, Quanjun Zhang, Kecheng Li, Chunrong Fang, Fangyuan Tian, Liuchuan Zhu, Jianyi Zhou, Zhenyu Chen. Unit testing is crucial for detecting bugs in individual program units but consumes time and effort. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in generating unit test cases.

arxiv-2409-13554.title: Mechanical Model for a Full Fusion Tokamak Enabled by Supercomputing
arxiv-2409-13554.creator: W. M. E. Ellis, L. Reali, A. Davis, H. M. Brooks, I. Katramados, A. J. Thornton, R. J. Akers, S. L. Dudarev
arxiv-2409-13554.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by W. M. E. Ellis, L. Reali, A. Davis, H. M. Brooks, I. Katramados, A. J. Thornton, R. J. Akers, S. L. Dudarev. Determining stress and strain in a component of a fusion power plant involves defining boundary conditions for the mechanical equilibrium equations, implying the availability of a full reactor model for defining those conditions.

arxiv-2503-12990.title: How Good is my Histopathology Vision-Language Foundation Model? A Holistic Benchmark
arxiv-2503-12990.creator: Roba Al Majzoub, Hashmat Malik, Muzammal Naseer, Zaigham Zaheer, Tariq Mahmood, Salman Khan, Fahad Khan
arxiv-2503-12990.description: Abstract Recently, histopathology vision-language foundation models (VLMs) have gained popularity due to their enhanced performance and generalizability across different downstream tasks. However, most existing histopathology benchmarks are either unimodal or limited in terms of diversity of clinical tasks, organs, and acquisition instruments, as well as their partial availability to the public due to patient data privacy.

arxiv-2509-19005.title: Quantum Annealing for Minimum Bisection Problem: A Machine Learning-based Approach for Penalty Parameter Tuning
arxiv-2509-19005.creator: Renáta Rusnáková, Martin Chovanec, Juraj Gazda
arxiv-2509-19005.description: Abstract The Minimum Bisection Problem is a well-known NP-hard problem in combinatorial optimization, with practical applications in areas such as parallel computing, network design, and machine learning. In this paper, we examine the potential of using D-Wave Systems’ quantum annealing solvers to solve the Minimum Bisection Problem, which we formulate as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization model.

pmc-11441104.title: Management of analgosedation during noninvasive respiratory support: an expert Delphi consensus document developed by the Italian Society of Anesthesia, Analgesia, Resuscitation and Intensive Care (SIAARTI)
pmc-11441104.creator: G Spinazzola, S Spadaro, G Ferrone, S Grasso, S M Maggiore, G Cinnella, L Cabrini, G Cammarota, J G Maugeri, R Simonte, N Patroniti, L Ball, G Conti, D De Luca, A Cortegiani, A Giarratano, C Gregoretti
pmc-11441104.description: BackgroundDiscomfort can be the cause of noninvasive respiratory support (NRS) failure in up to 50% of treated patients. Several studies have shown how analgosedation during NRS can reduce the rate of delirium, endotracheal intubation, and hospital length of stay in patients with acute respiratory failure.

pmc-11445881.title: Enhancing diagnostic accuracy: Direct immunofluorescence assay as the gold standard for detecting Giardia duodenalis and Cryptosporidium spp. in canine and feline fecal samples
pmc-11445881.creator: Juan P. Barrera, Guadalupe Miró, David Carmena, Carlos Foncubierta, Juliana Sarquis, Valentina Marino, Efrén Estévez-Sánchez, Begoña Bailo, Rocío Checa, Ana Montoya
pmc-11445881.description: The enteric protozoan parasites Giardia duodenalis and Cryptosporidium spp. are common cause of diarrhea in pet dogs and cats, affecting primarily young animals. This comparative study evaluates the diagnostic performance of conventional and molecular methods for the detection of G. duodenalis and Cryptosporidium spp. infection in dogs and cats.

pmc-11476003.title: iCardioMonitor Digital Monitoring System for People with Heart Failure: Development and Evaluation of Its Accessibility and Usability
pmc-11476003.creator: Set Perez-Gonzalez, Maria del Mar Fernandez-Alvarez, Noemi Gutierrez-Iglesias, Beatriz Díaz-Molina, Vanesa Alonso-Fernandez, Ruben Martin-Payo
pmc-11476003.description: Background/Objectives: The use of eHealth as a monitoring system in people with heart failure (HF) has been shown to be effective in promoting self-care and reducing re-admissions and mortality. The present study develops and evaluates the accessibility and usability of the web app iCardioMonitor HF monitoring system. Methods: This study consisted of two stages.

pmc-11555340.title: The spread of chemical biology into chromatin
pmc-11555340.creator: Esmat Hegazi, Tom W Muir
pmc-11555340.description: Understanding the molecular mechanisms underlying chromatin regulation, the complexity of which seems to deepen with each passing year, requires a multidisciplinary approach. While many different tools have been brought to bear in this area, here we focus on those that have emerged from the field of chemical biology.

pmc-12743913.title: Broström with InternalBrace Augmentation Significantly Improves Ankle Stability Measured by the Cumberland Ankle Instability Tool Compared to Broström Without Augmentation
pmc-12743913.creator: Steven Hadley, Rachel Bergman, Sarah Westvold, Tanya Kukreja, Carolyn Hu, Ryan Filler, Muhammad Mutawakkil, Milap Patel, Anish Kadakia
pmc-12743913.description: Research Type:Level 3 - Retrospective cohort study, Case-control study, Meta-analysis of Level 3 studiesIntroduction/Purpose:Limited data exist regarding whether primary Broström with InternalBraceTM augmentation bolsters ankle stability compared to Broström without augmentation. The Cumberland Ankle Instability Tool (CAIT) is a validated metric of ankle stability.

pmc-13166847.title: Delayed presentation of blunt scrotal trauma, an avoidable cause of testicular necrosis in an adolescent: a case report
pmc-13166847.creator: Florent Tshibwid A Zeng, Vincent de Paul Kaoma Cabala, Georgia Mwange Bibi Feza, Pitchou Mbey Mukaz, Sébastien Mbuyi-Musanzayi, Catherine Saleh Ugumba
pmc-13166847.description: Introduction and clinical importance:Testicular trauma is a rare cause of acute scrotum, mainly affecting adolescents. It frequently occurs during sporting activities, and ultrasound enables the diagnosis of testicular lesions and the selection of appropriate treatment.Case presentation:We report the case of a 15-year-old admitted 2 weeks after a left blunt scrotal trauma.

pmc-13379544.title: Estimating Eligibility for Lung Cancer Screening in Ireland: A Dynamic Modelling Study of Smoking Trends
pmc-13379544.creator: Tatiana Bezdenezhnykh, James F O’Mahony, Benjamin M Jacob, Patrick Redmond
pmc-13379544.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundLung cancer screening (LCS) with low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) reduces mortality. Ireland will likely adopt a national screening programme in the coming years, and evidence on the size of the eligible population is required to inform planning.ObjectiveThe objective was to estimate the number and characteristics of individuals in Ireland eligible for LCS under different international criteria and to project future uptake.MethodsWe combined population data from the 2022 Census and subsequent projections with smoking history from the 2017 Eurobarometer survey.

pmc-13451330.title: Development of an Oxford nanopore sequencing technology-based whole genome sequencing method for Plasmodium falciparum to support malaria molecular surveillance
pmc-13451330.creator: Catherine Bakari, Aurel Holzschuh, Misago D Seth, Rashid A Madebe, Dativa Pereus, Celine I Mandara, Pierre Schneeberger, Jonathan J Juliano, Jeffrey A Bailey, Deus S Ishengoma, Christian Nsanzabana
pmc-13451330.description: Whole genome sequencing (WGS) is critical for malaria molecular surveillance (MMS). While short-read platforms have been widely used for Plasmodium falciparum genomics; they have limitations in resolving repetitive regions and structural variation in this highly complex genome. Long-read technologies, such as those developed by Oxford nanopore technologies (ONT), offer complementary capabilities and may be particularly suitable for low-resource settings.

pmc-13572972.title: Performance trade-offs between dense prediction and sparse query mechanisms for brain tumor MRI detection: a comparative study of YOLOv8 and RT-DETR
pmc-13572972.creator: Lianxin Xie, Jinghui Chen, Zhipeng Sun, Yuhan Huang, Shan Ye, Chengbin Ye
pmc-13572972.description: ObjectiveThis study investigates optimal training strategies for YOLOv8s in brain tumor MRI detection, systematically evaluates the effects of key hyperparameters on model performance, and compares the adaptability and trade-offs between convolution-based dense prediction and Transformer-based sparse query mechanisms in medical image detection.MethodsExperiments were conducted on publicly available Kaggle MRI datasets of meningioma and glioma.

pmc-13668888.title: CDC AIDS Project 72: The Prostitute Study
pmc-13668888.creator: William W Darrow
pmc-13668888.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In the early years of the AIDS epidemic, the occurrence and potential for heterosexual transmission of human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV 1) in the United States were uncertain. To better understand infection among women and the possible role of prostitution in the emerging epidemic, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention established CDC AIDS Project 72, a multisite study of 1 410 women with recent histories of prostitution recruited from eight areas of the United States during 1986 and 1987.
